_comment: An Another World project brings the game as one file - a .zip of the game's folder (the DOS release's MEMLIST.BIN and BANK files, the Amiga's or the Atari ST's BANK files, the 15th Anniversary Edition's folder with Data/Pak01.pak, the 20th's with game/, Windows 3.1's with BANK, the 3DO's with GameData/), at its top or in a folder, names in any case; or the 3DO disc's image (.iso) as it is. The core unpacks a zip at start into memory no savestate carries, and reads a disc image where it lies. Windows 3.1's MIDI music is played with a SoundFont, if the project brings one.

slots.title: Game files
slots.help: A .zip of Another World's folder - DOS, Amiga, Atari ST, the 15th or 20th Anniversary Edition, Windows 3.1, the 3DO's GameData - or the 3DO disc's image (.iso).

slots.title: SoundFont (Windows 3.1 music)
slots.help: A General MIDI SoundFont (.sf2) to play the Windows 3.1 release's MIDI music with. Without one that music is silent, as rawgl without a MIDI synthesizer; nothing else of the game changes. The other releases do not use it.
